tasks.title: Heading in ENU
tasks.statement: The vehicle's heading in NED is ψ = **{y}°** (from north, clockwise). Find the yaw angle in ENU (degrees, from east, counterclockwise, in the range (−180…180]).

tasks.title: Position in ENU
tasks.statement: Position in NED: (**{n}**, **{e}**, **{d}**) m. Find the z component in ENU (m).
